messages.subject: Using data from previous tool (MGRAST) - input file doubt
parts:
Hi, I already did my analysis using MGRAST tool. 
I have a table with the relative abundance converted to log2 for my sample (3 replicates) at the phylum level. Is it possible to use this data to do the heat tree? I do not want to use my fasta files. 
Can I generate a input file based on my excel table? Please see my file attached. 

Thanks!

messages.author: 565fb8e7abc16eb0
messages.subject: Re: Using data from previous tool (MGRAST) - input file doubt
parts:
Hi Clarissa,

Yes, that can be used without much trouble, but with only domain and phylum, it might be a bit of a compact and unattractive tree. Can you get MGRAST to return any other ranks as well? Is this the standard output format of MGRAST?  Thanks,

-Zach
